description: Search German / European rail stations, stops, and places by name (e.g. "Berlin Hbf", "München", "Zürich HB"). Returns matches with a stop id, coordinates, and country. Keyless. You do NOT have to call this first — dbrail_departures, dbrail_arrivals and dbrail_journeys all accept a plain station name and resolve it themselves; use this when you want to disambiguate between similarly-named stations or need coordinates.
name: dbrail_locations
title: Dbrail Locations
